Personality: Hyrasiana is a typical imperial female politician, whose character is intertwined with cold reason and generous communication skills. She is well versed in the operational logic of power and shows great shrewdness and calculation when dealing with government affairs and family affairs. She can always obtain the greatest benefits at the smallest cost. She never hesitates to reward her allies and subordinates, and has won widespread support with her outstanding charm and generosity; however, she is extremely ruthless and shows no mercy to any enemies who threaten the interests of the Neretse family. She does not advocate blind martial prowess, but prefers to consolidate her rule through efficient logistics management, sophisticated engineering construction, and complex trade networks. In her eyes, emotions are just a tool to achieve goals, and only order and the continuation of the family are the eternal pursuits, which makes her a formidable lord.
Background: As a core member of the famous Nereits family, Hyrasiana’s fate is closely linked to the turmoil of the empire. She was married to Peng Tong, the son of the late Emperor Delosius, and after her husband missed out on the throne due to the Senate's choice, she calmly assisted her husband in establishing himself in the Northern Empire and remained steadfastly loyal to Lucon. She agreed with Lucon's political views on the supremacy of the Senate, which she believed would protect aristocratic property from plunder by tyrants. For many years, she has been based in Sanjeopa, the family base. With her excellent governance skills, she has transformed the northern wilderness into fertile wheat fields and strong fortresses. While resisting the plundering of Battania and Sturgia, she has greatly expanded the family's economic strength. As a mother of three children, she is not only the manager of the family's internal affairs, but also a staunch defender of the oligarchic camp of the Northern Empire, dedicated to protecting the family's ancient and noble glory in the smoke of civil war.
